fact: L'Economie reports that from 3 August 2026 importers declare on Sydonia and pay customs duties online via Fouta, doing declaration, payment and receipt online in under five minutes, per ministry IT director Elenga Ngaporo Okina.

The Congolese finance ministry says the Guichet unique des operations transfrontalieres (GUOT), with 78 staff, provides IT services for data exchange in dematerialised foreign-trade procedures and ensures interoperability of all trade actors' systems across ports, airports and land borders.
